name: tori-v2
units: px on the 1024x1024 source canvas (y down)
angleConvention: degrees, + = clockwise on screen (same sign as CSS rotate()); L/R = screen left/right
transformModel: M(part) = M(parent) . T(dx,dy) . T(a) S(sx,sy) T(-a) . T(pivot) R(deg) T(-pivot); a = scale anchor (default pivot, or an entry of 'anchors'); a child first rotates about its own pivot and then follows its parent. Draw parts as one flat list sorted by z (z interleaves across the hierarchy, e.g. tail behind legs). CSS per part: left=x, top=y, width=w, height=h, transform-origin: -x px -y px, transform = <root> <...ancestors> <part>, each level = translate(dx,dy) translate(ax,ay) scale(sx,sy) translate(-ax,-ay) translate(px,py) rotate(deg) translate(-px,-py). Reference implementation: scripts/v2/step5_rig.py (world_matrices / Rig.render).

root.originNote: bottom-centre between the feet (x = torso/hip centre, y = first row below the soles); place this point on the scene ground line
root.heightNote: feet line to the top of the tuft (alpha>=128)

tail.pivotNote: tail root behind the torso (step-4 root fill), so the curl swings while the root stays hidden
tail.limitsNote: +-8: beyond, the root area between arm and torso shows the step-4 stem fill shapes.

legL.pivotNote: centre of the hip-cap half-ellipse filled under the torso in step 4 (hip joint)
legL.limitsNote: +-20 clean (hip caps stay under the torso).

legR.pivotNote: centre of the hip-cap half-ellipse filled under the torso in step 4 (hip joint)
legR.limitsNote: +-20 clean (hip caps stay under the torso).

torso.pivotNote: hip centre between the two hip caps (lean / sway); legs are root children so the feet stay planted
torso.limitsNote: +-5 lean about the hips with the legs planted; children follow.

pendant.pivotNote: top of the acorn stem where it hangs from the collar
pendant.limitsNote: +-10 clean (the hole behind it was filled in step 4).

armL.pivotNote: centre of the rounded shoulder end (between the cap-circle centre and the old top-edge midpoint), hidden under collar_front: the arm turns like a ball joint
armL.limitsNote: + = raise outward. ~+75 is the useful maximum: beyond ~80 the arm goes behind the head's cheek. Inward (-) kept to 15: further, the shoulder bulge leaves the collar end and a background notch opens.

armR.pivotNote: centre of the rounded shoulder end (mirror of armL), hidden under collar_front
armR.limitsNote: - = raise outward (wave: -60..-75). Inward (+) kept to 15 (background notch under the collar end beyond). Raising past ~-45 reveals the tail stem behind the arm (step-4 fill) and a small armpit opening between body and tail (~100 px at -75) - background seen between body and tail, not a seam.

collar_front.pivotNote: rigid part of the torso (same pivot, never rotated on its own; limits 0)

earL.pivotNote: ear base where the ear enters the head outline (step-4 ear-bottom fill is behind the head)
earL.limitsNote: +-15 (+-20 works but the inner-ear fill under the head shows a small notch).

earR.pivotNote: ear base where the ear enters the head outline
earR.limitsNote: +-15 (+-20 works but the inner-ear fill under the head shows a small notch).

tuft.pivotNote: tuft root ~14 px below the head outline at the centre of the contact span (base hidden behind the head)
tuft.limitsNote: +-5 fully clean; +-8 shows only a 1-2 px straight sliver of the hidden base at the lifting side; at +-10 that sliver is clearly visible (2-4 px) -> limit 8, idle sway 4-6 recommended.

head.pivotNote: neck: under the head's bottom edge, inside the step-4 neck/collar fill
head.limitsNote: +-8 clean (step-4 neck/collar fill shows a few px of straight collar end above the rounded end); at +-10 small corner gaps between head edge and collar fill.

breath.use: torso scaleY (breathing / squash) anchored at the feet line; children (head, arms, tail, pendant, collar_front) follow; legs are root children so they stay planted

lean.use: body lean / sway = torso rotation about the hip centre (feet stay planted)

headBob.use: head squash (scaleY ~0.97-1.03) anchored at the neck

tuft.flat_colour_sample: median of 22703 opaque head px in x300-720,y170-260 within 12 of tan (stripes excluded)

base_extension.shape: convex hull of the completed left/right lobe ellipses (bbox [429, 113, 491, 166] / [535, 103, 584, 167]) and a U (x 467..555, straight to y=192, round bottom to y=216), clipped to the contact span x 447.5..574.5, kept only where the head is opaque (hidden)

combined_poses.pose: wave: armR max raise (-75), armL 10, head +5, earR -8, tuft +6
head tilt min (-8) + ears (earL +15, earR +15) + tuft max
head tilt max (8) + ears (earL -15, earR -15) + tuft min
walk A: legL +15 legR -15, armL -15 armR -15, torso +2, tail +8
walk B: legL -15 legR +15, armL +15 armR +15, torso -2, tail -8
hop squash: torso sy 0.97 sx 1.02 (breath anchor), legs +-8 out, arms out 30
breath in: torso sy 1.03 (anchor breath = feet line), head -3, tuft +5
